body:
PR #2721 head 2481458f0b (merge of origin/main d29b69c35c, normal push). The PR diff against main is now docs-only: 5 docs/testing files. Code, AGENTS, OVERVIEW and docs/cli conflicts: the branch had #2714's pre-merge head, so I took main's versions. Commit uses (Refs TASK-1800) because ACs remain unmet.

AC1 (classify the frozen-50 refusals): UNMET. 18 of 50 are done in docs/testing/task-1800-semantic-audit.{md,json}; 32 remain. It is not mechanical: each case needs manual source and contract adjudication, and the per-case inputs are in codex's local relay evidence/session*, not the doc. Your 10-17 ruling also stops further audit slices, so I did not extend it.
AC2 (cut the full-file fallback rate without dropping a true touch): UNMET. #2711 and #2714 (merged) only ADD evidence; per their own remeasurement fallback stays at 50 cases / 290 pairs. Non-Rust files still always use full-file fallback (aida-cli-lib/src/mandate_traces.rs:417) and the Rust fallback logic is unchanged. #2741 (merged, dangling trace ids) cuts refusals, not fallbacks. Remaining: enclosing-module item attribution plus non-Rust hunk scoping; regression check that the 17 inventoried cases keep every true ID, including full-file-only STORY-1218@2669 and TASK-1731@2686; before/after refusal and fallback counts on the same frozen 50 (none has been recorded since #2741).
AC3 (ADD-only, fail-closed): MET. #2711 and #2714 are additive with regressions. #2741's dangling-trace-id drop follows your operator-approved 10-17 ruling; named ids still fail closed.

Gate: make check-ci-fast passed every gate except 'Removed mode-flag spelling guard'. That guard fails on main itself: docs/plans/2026-10-19-backlog-triage.tsv:78, from d29b69c35c (TASK-1944), quotes 'aida graph <ID> --tree'. CI runs that guard only when full_ci is set, and that docs-only commit skipped it, so the next code PR's CI will go red on it. That file is not in this PR. I ran the 9 gates after it from ci.yml's step bodies (portability with the PR context substituted); all passed. Not merged, not self-approved.
subject: PR-2721 updated (TASK-1800)
